newsitem.title: GERMANY: German traders bid for free market grain rebates.
newsitem.headline: German traders bid for free market grain rebates.

text.p: German traders bid for 37,100 tonnes of free market wheat exports with a range of restitutions from 0.99 Ecus to 8.70 Ecus per tonne, intervention board BLE said.
BLE also received bids for the export of 4,000 tonnes of free market barley where the desired rebates were in a 24.58-27.14 Ecu range.
Traders also applied for rebates in a 26.47-27.95 Ecu range for the export of 20,800 tonnes of free market rye.
In addition, they sought to export 50 tonnes of rice.
